claims.disproof_condition: 條件：Enerflex 之後的季報或 6-K 寫出表後發電在手訂單下降、專案取消或交期延到 2028 年以後，或 Engineered Systems 擴產投資縮減。核查頻率：每季（Enerflex 季報）。觸發後 48 小時：降這條邊 confidence，重讀現場燃氣發電層的機組整合商讀法。
claims.statement: Enerflex 6-K (2026-10-13): contracted to design, engineer, fabricate and assemble over 1 GW of low-emission behind-the-meter natural-gas-fired power generation units for a large-scale North American data center development; with the ~450 MW award of 2026-10-01, its behind-the-meter gas power backlog exceeds 1.75 GW, deliveries through 2028; about USD 100 million authorized to expand Engineered Systems facilities. Customers are not named, and the release does not say whether the units use reciprocating engines or turbines, or whose.

aliases: onsite natural gas and power generation

source_doc.title: Enerflex 新聞稿（6-K Exhibit 99.1，2026-10-13）：拿到超過 1 GW 低排放表後燃氣發電機組設計製造案（北美大型資料中心開發案），表後燃氣發電在手超過 1.75 GW、交期到 2028；授權約 1 億美元擴充 Engineered Systems 產能

sources.quote: The Company has been contracted to design, engineer, fabricate, and assemble over one gigawatt of low emission behind-the-meter natural gas-fired power generation units for a large-scale North American data center development.

Combined with additional project awards, including approximately 450 megawatts announced on October 1, 2026, Enerflex’s backlog of behind-the-meter natural gas-fired power generation now exceeds 1.75 gigawatts, with deliveries extending through 2028.

As previously announced, Enerflex has authorized approximately $100 million of investments in its ES facilities and capabilities, $15 million of which is included in Enerflex’s capital expenditure guidance for 2026.
